journeyHeading: You'll know every step before you take it

steps.title: Finding the path
steps.body: Stepping onto this path begins with clearing the brush and packing your emotional bags with care and intention. Together with your guide, you plot the map of your inner landscape, ensuring your feet feel firmly grounded before taking the first step.

steps.title: The journey inward
steps.body: Here, you cross the threshold into a deep, uncharted forest where the mind's familiar trails gently fade away. As you walk through these vivid, unexpected vistas, you lean into the steady presence of your guide and trust each step of the unfolding journey.

steps.title: Finding your way back
steps.body: Returning from the woods, you gather the beautiful stones and insights you found along the trail to build a permanent home. This is where you walk the wisdom back into your daily routine, letting the new path become your familiar, everyday terrain.

heroHeading: Healing is winding path. Compassion and curiosity lead the way.
conditionsHeading: What are you seeking care for?

heroIntro: There is a world within — quieter and more resilient than you've imagined. This is a warm, rhythmic place to rest while you explore, with someone beside you the whole way.

conditions.title: Heaviness that just won't lift
conditions.body: When sadness has settled in and stayed — even after trying all the things that "they" told you to.

conditions.title: A mind that won't rest
conditions.body: Worry that looms behind everything, and the exhaustion that comes from always bracing for the next impact.

conditions.title: What unfolds in the path
conditions.body: Imagine being able to access the deepest parts of yourself and discovering that you have always been enough.

conditions.title: Have you always believed there was something more to life
conditions.body: For those who aren't in crisis, but sense there is more depth and aliveness available to them. Let's get curious.
